description: This file defines the class AOS_Products_Quotes, which extends AOS_Products_Quotes_sugar. It contains methods for saving quote lines, managing dependencies, and handling object persistence within the SuiteCRM framework, particularly related to product-quote associations.

classes.name: AOS_Products_Quotes
classes.description: Represents product-quote linkage with methods for saving, deleting lines, and relaying to parent objects within SuiteCRM.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that calls the parent constructor.

methods.name: save_lines
methods.description: Processes and saves multiple quote line items based on posted data, handling deletions, groups, and associations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Defines custom save logic and calls the parent save method after performing additional tasks.

methods.name: mark_lines_deleted
methods.description: Marks all product quote lines linked to a parent object as deleted.
